bagPolicy.summary: Permitted bags include clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags no larger than 13 by 17 inches, one-gallon clear zip bags, small hand-sized clutches, qualifying hydration packs, and waist packs. Medical exceptions are inspected individually.
allowed: Clear bag no larger than 13 by 17 inches
bagPolicy.note: Security makes the final decision at the gate. Review the current official policy immediately before the festival.

parking.note: There is no parking at the Bayfront Park festival site. Ultra recommends Brightline, Tri-Rail, Metrorail, or Metromover; downtown garages and rideshare services are available away from the entrance.

rideshare.note: Accessible pickup and drop-off is at Biscayne Boulevard and Chopin Plaza, in front of the InterContinental Hotel. Drivers must display a valid disability placard or plates.

concessions.note: Ultra hosts a rotating lineup of local and festival food vendors, including vegan options. Outside food and beverages are prohibited; current offerings are listed on the official food page.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: All entrances are accessible, and guests with disabilities plus one companion can use the Accessibility / Ultra Passport Entrance at Chopin Plaza on the south side of Bayfront Park, where free ADA wristbands are issued. Drivers with a valid placard can use the Accessible Passenger Loading Zone at Biscayne Blvd and Chopin Plaza. Wheelchairs and scooters are allowed, but Ultra does not rent them.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: There's no re-entry once you're inside, and no camping or staying overnight.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Orders can be collected at Will Call; bring a valid ID that matches the name on the order. Lost wristbands are canceled and moved to Will Call by Frontgate Tickets, and damaged or overtightened wristbands can be replaced at the Customer Service or Will Call tent.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: All entrances are accessible. Besides the GA and VIP entrances, guests with disabilities and one companion can use the Accessibility / Ultra Passport Entrance at Chopin Plaza on the south side of Bayfront Park, across from the Intercontinental Hotel.
